description:
# Build Brief: Household Chore Planner

Build a small household chore and admin-task planner. The primary goal is to help one or more people turn available time into a realistic, focused bundle of tasks.

## Core user flow
- A user adds chores or admin tasks, individually or as a batch.
- AI can propose missing task details, such as category, estimated duration, and recurrence.
- The user reviews and approves suggested details before tasks become recurring.
- The user selects available time: 5, 15, 30 minutes, or a custom duration; they may optionally filter by category.
- The app proposes a task bundle that fits the time and prioritizes overdue or due-soon tasks.
- The user enters a focused “doing” mode with a timer.
- Each task can be marked done, cancelled, or already completed.
- The app records the actual duration and completion outcome.
- After a session, the user can correct time taken and optionally rate task difficulty. AI may suggest updated future duration estimates based on past executions.

## Core data

### Task
- Name
- Category
- Estimated duration
- Optional recurrence
- Last completed date
- Next due date
- Status: proposed, approved recurring, active, or archived

### Task execution
- Task reference
- Session reference
- Start and end time
- Actual duration
- Outcome: done, cancelled, already done
- Optional difficulty rating
- Notes

### Work session
- Selected time budget
- Optional category filter
- Generated task bundle
- Start and end time

### Categories
- Admin
- Clean / Reset
- Fix
- Plan
- Organize
- Run Errands

Meals and groceries can initially be treated as subcategories of Run Errands.

## AI behavior
- AI may enrich raw task names with likely category, estimated duration, and recurrence.
- AI suggestions must always be reviewable and editable before saving.
- After enough execution history exists, AI may suggest revised duration estimates.
- Do not let AI silently change approved task data.

## Prioritization rules
- Prefer overdue tasks.
- Then prefer tasks due soon.
- Fit as many suitable tasks as possible within the chosen time budget.
- Avoid exceeding the chosen budget unless the user explicitly opts in.
- If a task is completed early, optionally show an additional task that fits the remaining time.

## First-version scope
Include task intake, approval, recurring tasks, time-based bundles, a timer-based doing mode, completion tracking, and basic AI enrichment.

Keep accounts, permissions, notifications, calendar integration, gamification, complex household assignment, and advanced optimization out of the first version unless they are essentially free in the framework.

tasks.description: Chores/admin tasks, from raw intake through approval and ongoing scheduling.

name.description: Task name as entered by the user.

category.description: Compatibility snapshot of the assigned category name, retained for legacy consumers.

categoryId.description: Stable _id of the approved category, initialized to null when unassigned.

locationIds.description: Distinct stable _ids of approved locations, initialized empty when unassigned.

recurrence.description: Approved recurrence interval in days, or null for a one-off task (numeric).

lastCompletedDate.description: Timestamp (ms) the task was last completed, or null.

nextDueDate.description: Timestamp (ms) the task is next due (numeric).

status.description: One of: proposed, approved_recurring, active, archived.

suggestedCategory.description: AI-suggested active category name, pending user approval.

suggestedDuration.description: AI-suggested duration in minutes, pending user approval (numeric).

suggestedRecurrenceDays.description: AI-suggested recurrence in days, pending user approval (numeric).

categories.description: User-managed task categories, including seeded defaults and archived values.

displayOrder.description: Numeric ordering value; newly added records append.

seedKey.description: Stable built-in default key, or null for custom categories.

locations.description: User-managed flat location references for task assignments.

displayOrder.description: Numeric ordering value; newly added records append.

taskExecutions.description: One record per task tackled during a doing-mode session.

actualDuration.description: Actual minutes spent, editable during review (numeric).

difficultyRating.description: Optional 1-5 difficulty rating set during review (numeric).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes set during review.

categoryFilterId.description: Stable _id of the optional category filter applied when the bundle was generated.

categoryFilter.description: Display-name snapshot of the optional category filter, retained for history compatibility.

taskBundle.description: Array of task _ids proposed for this session.
